import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141bd4120")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr)
out["containing"] = (str(f.getName()), str(f.getEntryPoint()), str(f.getBody())) if f else None
listing = prog.getListing()
it = listing.getInstructions(addr, True)
insns = []
cnt = 0
while it.hasNext() and cnt < 120:
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    ins = it.next()
    ops = []
    for i in range(ins.getNumOperands()):
        r = ins.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i)
        ops.append(r if r is not None else "")
    raw = ins.getBytes()
    hexb = "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in raw)
    insns.append([str(ins.getAddress()), ins.getMnemonicString(), ops, hexb])
    cnt += 1
out["insns"] = insns
print(json.dumps(out))
